cause_quote: The new snapshot rejected rosters over 200 rows via `sessions: row.array().max(200)` after capture filtered and mapped every row without truncating the list, and the Pages readiness check fell through to `Boolean(this.sessionData.sessionsResult)` after its dashboard catalog finished loading.
user_saw: After a warm reload, operators with large rosters saw session rows arrive late and shift the rail, while operators returning after a Pages visit could see the previous Sessions view restored.
summary: The fix caps the cached routing roster and lets Pages settle from its own catalog while preserving the last good snapshot if the catalog read fails.
reasoning: The introducing diff added both failure paths with the unified rail snapshot, after sidebar pagination and the owner-first window already existed. I checked the previous cache reader, which also rejected rosters above 200 rows, and confirmed that the later validation refactor carried the same cap into the new schema file.
